text:
margaret: FYI — The Verge just reached out asking for a quick methods line and a quote for the benchmark blog we posted. They want a concise confirmation of the hardware and whether our results include KV-cache. Can someone draft a reporter-ready sentence?
press_ops: On it. Do we have an existing boilerplate for hardware + methods? If not, I can craft a neutral line and run it past legal.
leah_legal: For speed: non-comparative, factual statements about test setup are fine. Any phrasing that implies superiority or specific percent improvements needs approval.
tom_eng: Method note we can share: "Benchmarks were run on Dedicated capacity (NVIDIA A100 equivalent), end-to-end P99 latency measured across 1k sampled LLM requests using our tokenized workload generator; caching disabled for baseline runs."
margaret: Good. Press_ops, please send that as the methods blurb. For the quote, keep it one sentence and avoid numeric claims.
press_ops: Draft quote for reporter: "We built these benchmarks to highlight how production-serving choices — batching, cache policy, and quantization — affect latency and cost in real deployments." Thoughts?
nina_social: For social, shorter punchier: "New benchmark: how smarter serving cuts latency & cost for real app workloads. Read more." We should include a link and an image card.
leah_legal: Approve both drafts as long as we don't claim "cuts X%" or use competitor comparisons.
press-bot: Media mention alert: incoming DM from Verge reporter with deadline in 45m.
press_ops: Ok I'm sending the methods note + reporter quote and asking for a 45m window. If they publish before legal signs off, we'll request any quotes be attributed as 'Redwood comment pending final approval'.
margaret: Also ask if they want an embargo — might buy us time.
press_ops: Reporter says no embargo, planning to publish tonight. Requested 45m hold, they accepted.
tom_eng: One small wording tweak to methods blurb: change "NVIDIA A100 equivalent" to "NVIDIA A100 series" for clarity.
press_ops: Updated and resent. Reporter replied they'll include our exact quote and methods note.
nina_social: Draft social post queued (T+10): ```Benchmark live: Production-focused results from Redwood Inference — see how serving choices impact latency & cost. short.redwood/bench``` Can someone confirm short link?
margaret: Use short.redwood/bench for now. If legal wants a change, update on the fly. Also add a quick ops play: notify CSMs if top customers are mentioned.
press-bot: External article published: The Verge piece live at https://theverge.example/redwood-bench (tracked). :loud_sound:
press_ops: Thanks everyone. Social team, amplify now. Ops, add to press tracker spreadsheet and flag any customer follow-ups. We'll document a faster micro-approval flow for same-day pickups in next week's comms playbook. :memo:
